verdicts.reason: A has ragged left edges: the logo sits at about x110, the headline at about 85, the subhead at about 92, and the chips at about 105–109. The CTA floats off-axis above the chips. The chips are oversized and wrap Honey Rosemary onto an orphan second row, and the subhead leaves 'long season.' dangling on its own line. B keeps a clean shared left edge and puts the CTA level with the subhead, but the gap between headline and subhead is too big and the bottom quarter is empty. Its chips are also in reverse order (Honey first, Blood Orange last), and their tiny text competes poorly with the large CTA.
